biomarkers.name: HPV / p16
biomarkers.prevalence: ~80-90% HPV-associated (mostly HPV-16); p16 overexpression is common in HPV-driven tumors
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature in most cases; generally associated with better prognosis than HPV-negative disease and with greater sensitivity to chemoradiation, although standard CRT (Nigro-type regimen) is used irrespective of HPV status

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 (CPS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Frequently expressed; prevalence varies by assay/cutoff and is not standardized
biomarkers.clinical_use: Checkpoint inhibitors have activity in metastatic/recurrent anal SCC. Retifanlimab has regulatory approval in some settings for advanced anal SCC; pembrolizumab and nivolumab have demonstrated activity in previously treated disease

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.prevalence: Uncommon in HPV-positive tumors and more common in HPV-negative tumors
biomarkers.clinical_use: HPV-positive tumors usually retain wild-type TP53 functionally inactivated by viral E6; TP53-mutant disease is enriched in HPV-negative tumors and is associated with poorer outcome in several series

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent mutation in anal SCC; currently mainly relevant for clinical trials rather than standard targeted therapy

biomarkers.name: HIV status
biomarkers.prevalence: Overrepresented among patients with anal SCC relative to the general population
biomarkers.clinical_use: HIV status is clinically important; continue ART. Outcomes can be comparable with modern HIV management, though treatment tolerance and toxicity require attention

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Squamous cell carcinoma, most often non-keratinizing (basaloid) type in HPV-driven disease
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Traditional SCC grading; less prognostic than HPV status

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Often inflamed — HPV-driven immune activation is associated with PD-L1 expression in a subset of tumors

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Basal keratinocytes of anal canal transition zone; anal intraepithelial neoplasia (AIN) / HSIL is the precursor
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Endoderm (hindgut) transitioning to ectoderm at the anal verge — the dentate line approximates this transition
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Keratinizing or non-keratinizing squamous; HPV-driven biology similar to cervical and HPV+ oropharyngeal SCC
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Anal high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) is the recognised precursor; HPV integration and E6/E7 expression drive transformation
